summary: Offer native Dismiss and Snooze for 1 hour in the web Alerts row menu, with an Undo that stays available after the row leaves the inbox.

replay.detail: Controls and Undo are sent through the shared optimistic alert actions; the web UI adds no request identity of its own.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

compatibility.detail: Controls appear only on alerts that carry a presentation control; servers still enforce capability and authorization.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
